name: Box Inbound
idea: Four players line up in a box by the basket, and two screens give the inbounder three places to pass.
why: Screens near the basket make the defenders choose. If they stay with the shooters, the screener is open under the hoop. If they stay with the screener, a shooter is open.
tryit: Screeners: wait for “Go!”, set your screen, then turn and face the ball. Inbounder: look at the corner first, then at the screener diving to the hoop.

frames.say: {1} passes the ball in from behind the baseline. The other four stand in a *box*: two by the basket and two at the free-throw line.
*Go!* {4} and {5} step down and set *screens* on {X2} and {X3}.
{3} pops out toward the corner and {2} runs up to the top. {X2} and {X3} get stuck on the screens!
{X5} jumps out to stop {3}. Now nobody is guarding {5}!
{5} turns and dives to the hoop.
Layup! In a box play, every screen gives the inbounder another player to pass to.
